description: This file defines schemas related to Row Level Security (RLS) in the Superset project, including data validation schemas and API method overrides.

classes.name: RolesSchema
classes.description: Schema for role data with name and id fields.

classes.name: TablesSchema
classes.description: Schema for table data with schema, table_name, and id fields.

classes.name: RLSListSchema
classes.description: Schema for listing RLS filters, including id, name, filter_type, roles, tables, clause, change info, group key, description, and who changed it.

classes.name: RLSShowSchema
classes.description: Schema for detailed view of a single RLS filter with id, name, filter_type, roles, tables, clause, group key, and description.

classes.name: RLSPostSchema
classes.description: Schema for creating a new RLS filter with required fields: name, filter_type, tables, roles, clause, and optional description and group_key.

classes.name: RLSPutSchema
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing RLS filter with optional fields.
